items.html: A competent wicketkeeper, Irani went on the tour of Australia in 1947-48 and played in the first two Tests. He then lost his place to P Sen and did not represent the country again. He played for Sind in the Ranji Trophy and during a first class career that lasted from 1937 to 1948, he scored 399 runs (17.34) and made 27 dismissals, 21 of them caught. (Partab Ramchand)
